_comment: Curated corrections for backend/scripts/import_landmarks.mjs. Keys are '<source_name>:<source_record_id>'. Fields: include (keep a record the type rules drop; give category), exclude (reason string), name, description, category, prominence (1-4), geofence_radius_m (10-2000), drop_polygon, no_match (LPC: never merge into another landmark), district_ok (large polygon is intended), needs_review, review_note, note (why; shown in the report).

montreal-lieux-interet:353.note: Saint Joseph's Oratory: basilica, gardens and Way of the Cross on a large hillside site; 200 m from the basilica covers the grounds and the front steps.

montreal-lieux-interet:2432.note: Notre-Dame Basilica: large church facing Place d'Armes; 70 m includes the square side.

montreal-lieux-interet:2976.review_note: Old Port runs ~2 km along the river; a 300 m circle around the central point covers only the middle quays.

montreal-lieux-interet:2516.note: Biosphère: 76 m geodesic dome; source niveau 3 understates it.

montreal-lieux-interet:1785.note: Jardin botanique: botanical garden; polygon from the green-space dataset.

montreal-lieux-interet:1103.note: Biodôme: living museum in the former Olympic velodrome.

montreal-lieux-interet:2840.note: Place des Arts: performing-arts complex around a large esplanade.

montreal-lieux-interet:2721.note: Observatoire Place Ville Marie (rooftop observation deck).

montreal-lieux-interet:2161.note: Marché Bonsecours: 1847 market hall, listed by the source as a museum.

montreal-lieux-interet:1165.note: Stade Olympique: stadium + tower footprint ~300 m across.

montreal-lieux-interet:2728.note: La Ronde amusement park covers ~0.5 km².

montreal-lieux-interet:2421.note: Casino de Montréal: former Expo 67 pavilions.

montreal-lieux-interet:2448.review_note: Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve is a 4.4 km loop around Île Notre-Dame; only the part around the point is covered.

montreal-lieux-interet:2405.review_note: Olympic basin is ~2 km long; only the middle is covered.

montreal-lieux-interet:3063.note: Stade IGA (tennis centre in parc Jarry).

montreal-lieux-interet:2694.note: Île Notre-Dame (~1.7 km island; the Parc Jean-Drapeau polygon also covers it).

montreal-lieux-interet:2195.note: Palais des congrès spans several blocks.

montreal-lieux-interet:2861.note: Place Ville Marie: iconic cruciform tower (source type: shopping centre).

montreal-lieux-interet:1669.note: Marché Jean-Talon: open-air market ~150 m across.

montreal-lieux-interet:2587.note: Croix du mont Royal (fenced; viewing area around it).

montreal-lieux-interet:2435.note: Belvédère Kondiaronk (large terrace in front of the Chalet).

montreal-lieux-interet:2223.note: Parc du Mont-Royal: 190 ha polygon from the Grands parcs dataset; the Site patrimonial du Mont-Royal (LPC SD/SP) is merged into it.

montreal-lieux-interet:2232.note: Parc Jean-Drapeau: polygon covers Île Sainte-Hélène and Île Notre-Dame.

montreal-patrimoine-lpc:86.note: Façade of the Great Scottish Life building; one alternate name mentions 'côte de la Place-d'Armes' and wrongly matched Place d'Armes.

montreal-patrimoine-lpc:155.name: Vieux-Montréal (Site patrimonial de Montréal)
montreal-patrimoine-lpc:155.note: Declared heritage site = Old Montréal; district-scale polygon kept on purpose.
